title: the `!T` fallible-return marker is retired: use Result<T, E>
notes: specification/failures.mdx, 'Inference', and specification/type-system.mdx, 'Public Boundaries', both say Smithers MUST NOT add a `!T` failure-annotation grammar. The second diagnostic is the real cascade and is declared rather than filtered: with the retired marker removed the annotation is a bare `string`, which specification/failures.mdx, 'Compiler Lifting', requires to be rejected because it cannot represent the reachable Missing exit.
